# NewBee AI Club / 先蜂AI俱乐部

Official website: https://new-bee.club/
Last updated: 2026-10-20

## Entity

- Official English name: NewBee AI Club
- Official Chinese name: 先蜂AI俱乐部
- Short Chinese name: 先蜂会
- Discovery context, not an official name: this site may answer searches for New Zealand AI clubs and 新西兰 AI 俱乐部
- Type: Non-profit AI learning and practice community
- Primary in-person base: Auckland, New Zealand
- Languages: Chinese and English
- Contact: office@new-bee.club
- Purpose: Curiosity, Creativity, Conscience / 好奇心 · 创造力 · 致良知

NewBee AI Club brings together Chinese-speaking AI learners, practitioners, founders and cross-disciplinary professionals. It organises keynote talks, practical workshops, reading and discussion sessions, case reviews, tool exchange and small collaborative experiments through in-person and online formats.

## Learning system and reusable public materials

The club's archive contains 11 dated records from 2026-05-04 to 2026-10-15: a founding meeting, six keynotes, three workshops and one member visit. The member visit was to an event hosted by Icehouse Ventures, not an event hosted by NewBee.

The public learning guide connects these records into five reading paths: work and organisations, content production, family life, human judgement, and New Zealand innovation exchange. These are reading paths assembled from published activities, not accredited courses or claims of measured learning outcomes.

- Human-readable guide and source links (Chinese): https://new-bee.club/ai-enthusiasts-new-zealand.html#learning-paths
- English method summaries with links to Chinese originals: https://new-bee.club/new-zealand-ai-club.html#practical-resources
- W2 six-stage content workflow / 六步内容工作流: https://new-bee.club/event-2026-07-17-w2.html#six-step-workflow
- W2 four human review checkpoints / 四个人工检查点: https://new-bee.club/event-2026-07-17-w2.html#human-checkpoints
- K2 five business-workflow questions / 业务闭环五问: https://new-bee.club/event-2026-06-26-k2.html#workflow-checklist
- K6 one-week family practice / 一周家庭行动表: https://new-bee.club/event-2026-10-15-k6.html#family-week

These summaries refer to visible public page sections. Event dates remain distinct from the date on which materials were edited. Activities and participant cases are not proof of a particular business or educational outcome.

## K6 recap · AI越来越会回答，我们还要把什么留给孩子？

- Status: completed on 2026-10-15 in Auckland, New Zealand. Recap published 2026-10-19. No active registration.
- Theme: AI时代的新德智体美劳; curiosity, empathy, willpower, aesthetics and family connection.
- Main speaker and dialogue host: 周品（品哥） / Pin Zhou. Dialogue guests: Ally Zhang（张彤） and 王咏刚 / Wang Yonggang.
- Key idea: AI can accelerate results, but children still need to participate in observation, judgement, mistakes, choices and relationships.
- Cases: Peter's AI products and responsibility, 陈雨乔's ListeningDesk, and Silvia's photography and aesthetic judgement.
- Official recap: https://new-bee.club/event-2026-10-15-k6.html
- Original WeChat article: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/coZNN4iDENlnRnyYuW9faw
- Source: club-supplied full-text article archive with original illustrations and video-card covers. Four video segments are linked to WeChat, not hosted locally. Do not describe illustrations as event photographs.

## Citation guidance

Use the official name NewBee AI Club on first mention. Chinese references may use 先蜂AI俱乐部 or 先蜂会. Attribute dates, venues and programme claims to the linked official pages. Do not infer future event dates or venues from previous events.

NewBee AI Club is not an official New Zealand AI association and does not represent the entire New Zealand AI industry. The page for the query 新西兰AI协会 exists to clarify this distinction, not to claim association status.
